name: Indian Contract Act
description: Governs contracts in India, defines agreement, consideration, capacity, free consent, lawful object

name: Transfer of Property Act
description: Governs transfer of property in India including sale, mortgage, lease, gift, exchange

name: Indian Evidence Act
description: Governs admissibility of evidence in Indian courts, burden of proof, examination of witnesses

name: Code of Criminal Procedure
description: Procedural law for administration of criminal justice, investigation, inquiry, trial, bail, arrest

name: Code of Civil Procedure
description: Procedural law for administration of civil justice, jurisdiction, suits, pleadings, execution

name: Limitation Act
description: Prescribes time limits for filing suits, appeals, and applications in courts

name: Consumer Protection Act
description: Protects consumer rights, establishes consumer disputes redressal commissions

name: Information Technology Act
description: Governs electronic commerce, electronic governance, cyber crimes, digital signatures

name: Companies Act
description: Governs incorporation, regulation, and winding up of companies in India

name: Arbitration and Conciliation Act
description: Governs domestic and international arbitration and conciliation in India

name: Right to Information Act
description: Provides right to information from public authorities, promotes transparency and accountability

name: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act
description: Protects women from domestic violence, provides relief and protection orders

name: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act
description: Prevents and redresses sexual harassment of women at workplace

name: Negotiable Instruments Act
description: Governs promissory notes, bills of exchange and cheques

name: Motor Vehicles Act
description: Governs road transport vehicles, licensing, insurance, offences and penalties

name: Environment Protection Act
description: Provides for protection and improvement of environment

name: Wildlife Protection Act
description: Protects wild animals, birds and plants

name: Forest Conservation Act
description: Provides for conservation of forests and related matters

name: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act
description: Provides for prevention and control of water pollution

name: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act
description: Provides for prevention, control and abatement of air pollution

name: Indian Succession Act
description: Governs succession and estate of deceased persons

name: Hindu Marriage Act
description: Governs marriage among Hindus, conditions, ceremonies, divorce

name: Hindu Succession Act
description: Governs intestate or unwilled succession among Hindus

name: Special Marriage Act
description: Provides for civil marriage irrespective of religion

name: Guardians and Wards Act
description: Governs matters relating to guardianship of minors

name: Indian Easements Act
description: Governs easements and licenses relating to land

name: Registration Act
description: Provides for registration of documents relating to property transactions

name: Workmen's Compensation Act
description: Provides for compensation to workers for injury caused during employment

name: Industrial Disputes Act
description: Provides for investigation and settlement of industrial disputes

name: Payment of Wages Act
description: Regulates payment of wages to certain classes of employed persons

name: Minimum Wages Act
description: Provides for fixing minimum rates of wages in certain employments

name: Employees' Provident Funds Act
description: Provides for institution of provident funds, pension funds and insurance funds for employees

name: Trade Unions Act
description: Provides for registration and regulation of trade unions

name: Shops and Establishments Acts
description: State-specific laws regulating employment in shops and commercial establishments

name: Indian Trusts Act
description: Defines and amends law relating to private trusts and trustees

name: Specific Relief Act
description: Defines and amends law relating to specific relief

name: Contempt of Courts Act
description: Defines and limits powers of courts in punishing contempt

name: Legal Services Authorities Act
description: Provides for establishment of legal services authorities for free legal aid

name: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO)
description: Protects children from offences of sexual assault, harassment and pornography

name: Juvenile Justice Act
description: Deals with children alleged or found to have committed offences and children in need of care

name: Prevention of Corruption Act
description: Consolidates and amends law relating to prevention of corruption

name: Prevention of Money Laundering Act
description: Prevents money-laundering and confiscation of property derived from money-laundering

name: Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Act
description: Prohibits benami transactions and recovery of benami property
